description: Return published TradingAgents report metadata and URLs newest first, the matching total and counts for all tickers. Use this to find reports before read_research_report, optionally filter by ticker and page with limit and offset.

limit.description: Maximum reports to return per call; integer from 1 to 100, default 20.

offset.description: Number of matching reports to skip, e.g. 20 for the next page with limit 20; integer from 0 to 9007199254740991, default 0.

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. NVDA; case-insensitive, 1–32 characters after trimming. Omit to list all tickers.

name: list_research_reports
title: List research reports
